doc: Linlong (林珑.pmx; Model Hotloader asset 801f3bcf, imported 2026-09-21, library name Linlong; the PMX was edited on 2026-11-16 (header name Linlong) after that import, with the same 30 materials, 99,476 vertices, 136,855 triangles, 731 bones and 37 morphs, so the import's textures and hashes are hers), reviewed 2026-11-16 for a Workshop-style pack. No game was running: every hash is an offline XXH64 prediction from the import's VTFs. She is a florist (her apron is printed 听花说, 'what the flowers say', she wears an employee badge and gardening gloves): sage-green and white cotton workwear with a woven leaf-line jacquard, an olive canvas vest and apron, navy under-layers, aqua embroidered lace, and real flowers and leaves in her hair and on her outfit. THE GAME'S OWN MAPS (the user, 2026-11-16: her folder already holds her PBR textures): extra texture\*_OD.png are the game's authored normal maps (RG normal, B occlusion, A a mask; they line up with the MMD sheets: edge correlation body2 0.22, body3 0.18, hair1 0.10, body1 0.27 at 1024 px for all three body1 variants alike, so the base body1_OD the user's own port used) and *_M.png packed toon masks (R specular, B material levels; no roughness or metalness). They are used as normal_map for body1, body2, body3, hair1 and hair2 with class normal 1.0 (the class defaults are tuned for weak AI normals); body1_OD's blue is occlusion too, but mostly white, so rpai's median test took it for z (median |b - z| 0.15, p90 0.61): body1 uses a copy with z rebuilt from red and green, work\linlong_801f3bcf\game\body1_OD_normal.png (the others are rebuilt by rpai itself). body4 (leaves, repainted for the MMD model: no game map matches) and the hair overlays sp1/sp2 keep AI relief. Sizes stay at 2048 (--max-size 2048: no upscale, the game's own resolution, 8 GB friendly), so the albedo is the game's. Roughness: class values with PBRify's variation at 2048. Parts: 12 体1 (classed skin by its name) is the outfit: cloth; inside it the gardening gloves (rect) are green nitrile-coated fingers (default, redefined on body1.png: 0.45) and a brown leather back (0.5), and the olive vest (rect) waxed canvas (hair, redefined: 0.55). 13 头饰 (the lilies and leaves in her hair), 14 花, 15 红花 (white-pink and red flowers) and 21 裙饰 (the outfit's flowers and leaf blades): petals (nail, redefined: 0.45, soft sheen) with their green leaves as leaf (wet, redefined: waxy 0.35). 16 饰 trims cloth; 17 袜 the white knit socks with a lace pattern (the stockings rule took them for nylon): cloth; the laminated employee badge card (drawn by 体1 inside a rect; 18 工牌_Alpha, classed skin by its texture name, is its alpha overlay): rubber 0.18. body2.png: 19 裤, 22/23 裙内, 24 裙, 25 the skirt, under-skirt, bodice and apron: cloth, the olive apron, straps and pockets waxed canvas (hair, 0.55) and the apron's white 听花说 print rubber 0.32 (a plastisol print). 26 花2 (body3.png) is aqua embroidered lace, not flowers: cloth 0.5. 27 叶 (body4.png) the leaves: leaf. Hair (前髪, 髪 and the overlays 前髪+, 髪+) 0.38. Face anime-safe. Skin (肌, skin.png) left to Remix; the painted shadows 目影 and 髮影 get no PBR (the companion leaves them out of the draw). UPDATE 2026-11-16, the user's report from the field game ("the hair's rendering looks off as the color is not uniform"; "the PBR effect is too weak and not obvious"): THE HAIR SHEETS paint hard-edged cream, pink and orange-brown blocks on separate islands; they met in hard edges wherever the hair twisted or lay in clumps, with or without the layer (a plain red test albedo in game removed every block, so they are the texture's, not the light's). hair1.png and hair2.png therefore use evened copies (albedo_source; scripts/even_albedo.py with its defaults on both sheets together: the main tone L* 84.7 a* 2.2 b* 13.9 measured from them, the strand detail kept, 35% of the colour detail, 15% of the broad shading; broad L* spread 3.6 and 4.6 down to 1.0), the pink and orange-brown ends going with the blocks: the user's choice. THE STRENGTH (the user chose variant SP of S, SP and AI from an A/B in game, 4K, three views from her bones): the game's normal maps at 3.0 on body1, body2 and body3 (each class there), cloth 0.6 with rough_ai 0.65 (body3's lace 0.45), the waxed canvas 0.48, the gloves' leather 0.42, the leaves (wet) 0.28 with normal 2.2, the petals (nail) 0.38, the badge (rubber) 0.12, the apron's print 0.24; the hair 0.26 with its game normal maps at 2.4 and anisotropy -0.7 along the strands, on hair1, hair2 and the overlays sp1/sp2 only (the hair class is also the canvas, which keeps none). Measured against no layer: the shipped layer changed her by 2.6-4.7/255 with fine relief +2-5%, about the 1.6-3.6 repeat drift; SP 3.7-6.0/255 and +6-10%; S (2.0, hair 1.8/0.30/-0.5) +4-7%; rpai's AI normals instead of the game maps (2048, no upscale) only +1-2%. Published at 2048 (--max-size 2048), the painted shadows 目影 (shadow.png) and 髮影 (shadow2.png) left out of the layer as before.
